in_marathi.name: Dharmesh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharmesh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'dharma' (righteousness, duty) and 'mesh' (ruler, king). The name signifies a righteous ruler or a person who upholds dharma in his actions and thoughts.
